translation: Basabetha kuye bathi: Kumazwe akude kakhulu apha kwindawo equkuqileyo azele amazwe enu basebenza igama likaYahwe uElohim wakho, singavakalisi Ndiphelela ukusuka kwindawo equkuqileyo ilizwe elikude kakhulu; ukuze sibize igama likaYahwe uElohim wakho, kuba thina ndevu indaba zakhe, iindaba zokuphulwa kwendawo. Wait — ndilungisa: Sithetha ngokusuka kulizwe elikude kakhulu, bazanya abantu bakho bengamathe! — REMAINDER UNDER REVISION: Basilandelwa nguScott (umva we-automation). Nanga amazwi abo: From a land very far away, kusukela kumazwe amakhulu aphesheya, basebenzela igama likaYahwe uElohim wakho, kuba besiva indaba zakhe, nangaphezu kokuba siva zonke izinto awayenzayo eMitsrayim. (Uluhlu lwamagama alungisiweyo lwalungileyo: uYahwe, uElohim, iMitsrayim; inguqulelo ngokupheleleyo iya kwenziwa emva kokuqinisekiswa.)
